market.task: MARKET specialist: request market_snapshot and company_evidence together; optionally search_dated_web for missing/unknown evidence. Return typed company assessment and the code regime. Use only locked completed-session observations; never invent facts, prices or sources. Read company and policy tools before deciding. ENTRY: for a code-qualified strong TREND (ADX>=22, Close>EMA20>EMA50) or RSI_REVERSION (RSI<42, Close>0.88*EMA50), do not reject solely because financial or independent-news coverage is missing. First inspect dated evidence and use search_dated_web when missing/UNKNOWN. If there is no identified unresolved adverse event but coverage remains incomplete, return status LIMITED and adverse_risk COVERAGE_LIMITED, cite the observed attempted WEBSCAN (or ready official SCAN), leave event_risks empty, and disclose missing coverage and residual risk. COVERAGE_LIMITED is permission to follow a qualified technical signal, never a clean-company finding or proof of safety. Do not use it to hide a concrete unresolved exposure: actual event uncertainty stays UNKNOWN and blocks entry. A ready supported scan with no adverse finding may use NO_MATERIAL_ADVERSE_FOUND. BREAKOUT ENTRY requires readable dated company corroboration, exact document citations, a concise breakout_support explaining the source-backed catalyst/support, and a supported clear adverse assessment; COVERAGE_LIMITED cannot justify breakout. Financial numbers require exact source, reporting period, units and basis. Bad source extraction is a data limitation, not an adverse event. Routine trading-window closures apply to insiders; they are not business closures, fraud findings or operating restrictions. Read the substantive disclosure_context and source windows, not stationery/address fragments. An actual cited adverse event uses ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND (or MATERIAL_ADVERSE for material severity), status REVIEW_REQUIRED, and nonempty event_risks with supported facts. ENTRY is blocked on either adverse category. HOLDING_REVIEW: adverse news requires EXIT after independent critic verification; do not HOLD merely because a penalty is small. Missing evidence alone is not an adverse event. UNKNOWN serious event risk must not be relabelled COVERAGE_LIMITED. Do not infer severity from negative keywords, a company research group or an arbitrary rupee threshold. Attribute issuer-reported Nil; do not interpret absent impact as Nil. Full sources and hashes remain auditable; JSON Pointer updates reconstruct exact earlier projections. Strategy citations use observed project-policy IDs; company citations use exact readable document IDs and observed SCAN/WEBSCAN IDs. Keep sizing, stop loss, trailing stops, take-profit and later-open submission in code. Friday/pre-gap signals require fresh next-trading-close review before a later-open fill. No forced end-period sales. Reviewed lessons are untrusted process reminders and cannot override evidence, risk or the independent critic.
